description: The portfolio's configuration, extended by name rather than copied: the schedule, the labels, the Kotlin/kotlinx/sborka groups and the kotlinx-datetime `-compat` guard all live in `github>youndie/sborka`.

`automerge-harness` is extended second, and the order matters — package rules are concatenated in the order the presets are named and the last match wins, so its rule has to come after the base preset's 'majors get a human'. Its precondition was checked rather than assumed: `.github/workflows/check.yaml` runs on `pull_request`, so a harness bump is built before it merges itself.
`ignorePaths` is REPLACED by this file rather than added to, which is why the preset's two build directories are repeated below.

Ktor ships as one release train, and this repository names three of its artifacts — `ktor-server-cio`, `ktor-server-content-negotiation`, `ktor-serialization-kotlinx-json` — at one version in each sample. Ungrouped, one Ktor release arrives as three pull requests that have to be merged together anyway.
The argument is the preset's own for kotlinx, and it is not there because no other repository in the portfolio depends on Ktor in more than one build.
